item.title: Gas Prices Still Climbing As War In Iran Continues - Mid-Utah Radio
item.description: (Brigham City, UT) -- Gas prices are still climbing as the U-S war in Iran continues. Statewide, the average price for a gallon of self-serve regular is 3-dollars and 94-cents. Triple-A says that's two-cents below the national average. The most expensive average price can be found in Beaver County where gas is 4-dollars and 30-cents.

item.title: Snow Men’s Basketball Season Ends At Hands of Butler Tuesday - Mid-Utah Radio
item.description: HUTCHINSON, Kan.-Tristan Hankins posted 21 points and 11 rebounds as the No. 8 Butler Grizzlies downed No. 9 Snow 101-96 in the second round of the NJCAA Division I Men's Basketball Championship Tournament Tuesday at Hutchinson Sports Arena.
